messages.subject: ASML EU Recruitment | Director-Level Global Affairs, Government Relations & ESG Executive
messages.body:
Dear ASML European Recruitment Team,

I am reaching out regarding senior leadership opportunities where government relations, global affairs, regulatory strategy, ESG, stakeholder engagement and strategic partnerships intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major multinational operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. My strongest contribution is in leadership environments where public policy, institutional trust, geopolitical sensitivity, sustainability and disciplined cross-functional execution must be managed together.

ASML's global operating model, public-policy exposure, strategic technology position and cross-border regulatory environment make the company especially relevant to my next move. I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Global Affairs, Government Affairs, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Regulatory Strategy.

I am internationally mobile and open to relocation to the Netherlands or another European hub with employer-supported work authorization where required. I have attached an ASML-tailored executive CV for review and future matching. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates, or referral to the appropriate senior recruiter.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
